newsitem.title: LEBANON: Hizbollah threatens Katyusha attacks on Israel.
newsitem.headline: Hizbollah threatens Katyusha attacks on Israel.

text.p: Lebanon's pro-Iranian Hizbollah said on Friday it would resume Katyusha rocket attacks on northern Israel because a 1996 ceasefire understanding had failed to protect Lebanese civilians.

"We say the understanding has ceased to protect civilians. We say the resumption of using other means to protect civilians has become necessary," Hizbollah secretary-general Sheikh Hassan Nasrallah told a news conference.
Hizbollah threatens Katyusha attacks on Israel
"But the timing of using Katyushas to protect civilians has to do with the situation on the field...and a number of other similar considerations," he said.

Katyusha rockets fired by guerrillas in Lebanon slammed into a northern Israeli town early on Friday, slightly injuring a woman and damaging a synagogue, the Israeli military said. Nasrallah said Hizbollah was not responsible for the attack.
